topics.title: Soft Recovery Collar Alternatives to the Plastic Dog Cone
topics.targetKeyword: soft cone alternative for dogs eye
topics.ownerInsight: Breeds with prominent/bulging eyes (e.g. Chihuahuas) are prone to scratching their own eyes with a hind paw when rubbing an itchy or irritated eye, which can cause real corneal damage over time. Rigid plastic E-collars are the standard fix, but some dogs get ear irritation or even bleeding from the hard edge when they shake their head — which is why inflatable/padded fabric alternatives are worth covering as a real option, not just a novelty.

topics.title: How to Give a Picky Senior Dog Pills or Supplements (Without a Fight)
topics.targetKeyword: how to give a dog a pill picky eater
topics.ownerInsight: Some senior dogs are picky enough that they'll refuse even flavored pill-hiding treats unless it's a specific trusted brand/flavor they already like, which makes daily supplements and monthly chewable parasite-prevention medication (e.g. NexGard-type products) a recurring struggle rather than a one-time problem. A soft, moldable pill-wrap treat that can be shaped around a pill/capsule (rather than a fixed-shape pocket) tends to work better for dogs this fussy. This is a behavioral/practical tips topic, not medical advice — don't give dosing guidance, just coverage of the product category and technique.
